executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

saved_rate_certificate.arithmetic: Outward values and derivative intervals; fixed rational allocations; all public syndrome streams; signed OTP costs; whole [0,1].

terminal_schedule.wire_role_rule: Preparation order never swaps decoder inputs: logical left feeds wire 0 and logical right feeds wire 1.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Public syndrome exchange; no mask consumption.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

saved_rate_certificate.arithmetic: Exact rational Z-schedule bit law and yield; conditional-phase-degradation lemma; outward complete-code entropy bounds over a partition of the whole correlation interval.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Public syndrome exchange; no mask consumption.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

saved_rate_certificate.arithmetic: Outward values and derivative intervals; fixed rational allocations; all public syndrome streams; signed OTP costs; whole [0,1].

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

saved_rate_certificate.fallback_proof: Fixed no-OTP code: gross positive-syndrome sum >= k - n H(Bell) + H(HX). Renyi2 and Parseval give H(HX)>=n-k-log2(sum_dual delta^(2wt)). D(delta)>=delta^2/(2 ln2), log2(1+x)<=x/ln2, so same-code rate >= positive(delta^2/(2ln2)-H(Z|X)-sum_nonzero_dual delta^(2wt)/(n ln2)). Exact dual Hamming enumerator for simplex7: 1+7x^3+7x^4+x^7; SPC dual enumerator 1+x^n. No fallback upper is used.
saved_rate_certificate.arithmetic: Same frozen outward terminal/entropy engine and exact rational allocations; independent R-pump closed-form value/derivative enclosure; retained complete rational cell cover.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Public syndrome exchange; no mask consumption.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.

executable_AD.OTP: Encrypt the asymptotically compressed syndrome message with pre-shared uniform masks; net cost is H(S)/n per AD input bit. The source rate does not assume a free mask supply.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.OTP: Public syndrome exchange; no mask consumption.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

executable_AD.OTP: Public syndrome exchange; no mask consumption.

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Encrypt the asymptotically compressed syndrome message with pre-shared uniform masks; net cost is H(S)/n per AD input bit. The source rate does not assume a free mask supply.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Encrypt the asymptotically compressed syndrome message with pre-shared uniform masks; net cost is H(S)/n per AD input bit. The source rate does not assume a free mask supply.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Encrypt the asymptotically compressed syndrome message with pre-shared uniform masks; net cost is H(S)/n per AD input bit. The source rate does not assume a free mask supply.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Encrypt the asymptotically compressed syndrome message with pre-shared uniform masks; net cost is H(S)/n per AD input bit. The source rate does not assume a free mask supply.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.

executable_AD.protocol: Two-bit parity comparison with hashed reconciliation and privacy amplification
executable_AD.reference: Watanabe et al., arXiv:0705.2904v2, Theorem 3 Eq.(4)
executable_AD.executable_specification: For local pairs A1,A2 and B1,B2, form U1=A1 xor A2 and V1=B1 xor B2. Use the cited hashed reconciliation to determine W1=U1 xor V1. Define U2=A2 if W1=0 and U2=0 otherwise, and the analogous Bob variable. Reconcile and privacy amplify the resulting variables according to the cited two-stage protocol, accounting for every public hash. No OTP mask is used.

executable_AD.coordinate_encoding: Integer bit i represents coordinate i; coordinate 0 is least significant.
executable_AD.syndrome: S=H*(Alice_bits xor Bob_bits); all observed syndromes are kept as labeled streams before reconciliation.
executable_AD.classical_protocol: Apply the registered Du code protocol; reconcile each syndrome stream, then use a joint two-universal privacy-amplification hash with the proved total entropy bound. No hidden-state-dependent stream acceptance is required.
executable_AD.reconciliation_and_syndrome_cost: All public reconciliation is included in the rate expression; OTP masks, when selected, are separately paid and subtracted.
executable_AD.OTP: Public syndrome exchange; no mask consumption.
executable_AD.reference: Du et al., arXiv:2404.14733v2; the registered rate model specifies each OTP and hashing variant.
